sources.entry: Clipy - Clipy is a Clipboard extension app for macOS. Based on ClipMenu. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/Clipy/Clipy) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Clipy
summary.one_liner: Clipy is a free, open-source clipboard manager for macOS that keeps a clipboard history and stores reusable text snippets.
use_cases: Access earlier copied items on a Mac
Replace the default macOS clipboard with extended history
summary.what_it_does: Clipy extends the macOS clipboard to handle plain text, images and other formats. A keyboard shortcut opens a menu showing clipboard history so earlier items can be pasted again. Frequently used text can be saved as snippets and pasted at any time. The project is open source, accepting bug reports, feature requests and pull requests on GitHub. It is a remake of ClipMenu, which it credits as its basis.
notable: Based on and remake of ClipMenu
Keyboard shortcut opens clipboard history menu
caveats: Platform support is macOS only, as named on the page
Currently shares many features with ClipMenu; own features are planned rather than described
